title: Kind comments on my last post kept me going, so here's a small fight montage from my action RPG
author: Icy-Drop-9535
selftext: Thanks to everyone who commented on my last post, it really motivated me to keep going. I've been polishing the combat since then, so here's a small montage of some of my favorite moments from different fights. Any feedback on the combat, the scale (I made the characters bigger so they fit the environment better), or anything else is super welcome!

comments.author: Early_Flamingo5337
comments.body: Gameplay seems fun, art style a little non original imo, no offense, are planning on changing it or is it the main idea?

replies.author: Icy-Drop-9535
replies.body: No offense taken at all, thanks for the honest feedback! I'd love to give it more of its own identity over time, but finding good artists with free time is really hard(( Is there anything specific that feels too familiar to you?

comments.author: ItsDumi
comments.body: I like the depth of field but I think it needs to be a little wider. Therr are moments the npc is blurred and I can't see what it's doing or about to do.

replies.author: Icy-Drop-9535
replies.body: Thanks, that's a great point! Already fixed it, I widened the focus area so attacks are easier to read

comments.author: GoGs0l0dev
comments.body:
Honest question, the combat looks/feels smooth…but why the zoom and/or the size of the character models?

Seems it would look way better if zoomed in some.

comments.author: Ok-Investment4414
comments.body: looks nice but cant really see shit since as a the viewer is far AF

comments.author: Maple-Syrup89
comments.body: Cool style! Looks great. Love the tilt shift. How did you do the attack and blood effects?

replies.author: Icy-Drop-9535
replies.body: Thank you! The attack effects are modified slash assets made by NamuFX, the impacts are from the [Hit Slashes Vol. 1](https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/vfx/particles/hit-slashes-vol-1-104003) pack, and the blood sprites are from this [Blood FX pack](https://jasontomlee.itch.io/blood-fx).

replies.author: Icy-Drop-9535
replies.body: Thank you, glad you like it!

comments.author: Codingology
comments.body: How are you guys so great at making good visuals

replies.author: Icy-Drop-9535
replies.body: Haha thank you! Honestly it's a mix of things: I draw the pixel art myself, the 3D environments are bought or free assets, and a lot of the look comes from lighting and post-processing in Unity. Lots of trial and error!

comments.author: harveyzs
comments.body:
The graphics and the fluid movement are peak

How long did it take you to achieve this?

replies.author: Icy-Drop-9535
replies.body: Thank you so much! I've been working on it for almost a year now, mostly in my free time.

comments.author: the_masked_one_1234
comments.body: This is awesome bro. Great visual effects🤯

comments.author: rrcecil
comments.body: I really like the tilt view but I think maybe zoomed in more? Otherwise I’m interested a LOT

comments.author: MinimumEffort-Games
comments.body: Looks interesting, def keep working on it!
